newsitem.title: MEXICO: Eugenio Clariond new head of Mexico business group.
newsitem.headline: Eugenio Clariond new head of Mexico business group.

text.p: Eugenio Clariond Reyes Retana was unanimously elected as president of the Mexican Council of Bussinessmen (CMHN), the council said on Thursday.
Clariond Reyes Retana, who is president of the Monterrey-based Grupo Industrias Metalicas Monterrey (IMMSA), received the vote of all 35 members of the council, according to a CMHN news release.
He will assume the presidency of the CMHN in the first half of July, the council said.
